precepts.text: There is history behind why Paul said let the women keep silence in the churches. In Ephesus and that whole region around Corinth they worshipped the great goddess Diana, whom all Asia and the world worshipped, and the people cried out for two hours, Great is Diana of the Ephesians. Some of those women repented, so to speak, came into the church, and brought that goddess spirit with them. That whole feminist movement is the same spirit back today.
precepts.point: Whenever you are having these issues in your household, it is because you allowed confusion to breach. You allowed feminism in the house; you did not stop it at the door. You allowed pride to come in.

note.label: Agree Together | Bound Not Bondage

precepts.why:
“For God is not the author of confusion, but of peace, as in all churches of the saints. Let your women keep silence in the churches”. Why does that follow right after God is not the author of confusion? Because a woman speaking out of turn concerning the church is confusion. A woman not being in order is confusion.

There is history behind why Paul said to let the women keep silence in the churches. Acts 19: “And it came to pass, that, while Apollos was at Corinth, Paul having passed through the upper coasts came to Ephesus”. This is what was happening in that whole region of Corinth and Ephesus.

The craftsmen feared “that the temple of the great goddess Diana should be despised, and her magnificence should be destroyed, whom all Asia and the world worshippeth.” Who were they worshipping? The great goddess Diana. And when they knew Paul was a Jew, “all with one voice about the space of two hours cried out, Great is Diana of the Ephesians.”

That goddess worship ran through Corinth and that whole area. Some of those women repented, so to speak, came into the church, and brought that goddess spirit with them. That whole feminist movement is the same spirit, back today, and sisters do not want to admit that is the spirit they are rolling in. Feminism has been normalized to where a man has to whisper in his own house.

So when there are issues in your household, it is because you allowed confusion to breach: you let feminism and pride in and did not stop them at the door. If you are scared of your wife, brother, take the purple shirt off; you cannot cast down the lies of the nations and bring us out of captivity if you are scared to deal with your wife at home. The head of every man is Christ, and the head of the woman is the man; that is the divine order, and God is not the author of confusion.

precepts.text: Let all things be done decently and in order. The Lord is about order; he is not going to keep bringing the same member into the body. Can everybody be a teacher? Then who is going to read?
precepts.point: Each and every one of you has been gathered here for a purpose, brought into this body to benefit the nation. For those who think you are insignificant: God called you in here, so you had better apply your gifts and talents, because if you do anything other than that, you are going against God.

note.label: Member's In The Body

precepts.why:
God set the members in the body “as it hath pleased him”, and Paul says: “Let all things be done decently and in order.” The Lord is about order. He is not going to keep bringing the same member into the body, just hands and more hands; that is not how this works.

Understand how the scriptures use the body: it goes into functions. Can everybody be a teacher? Then who is going to read? Can everybody be the one for camp? Change is coming, because we have grown into a nation, and there are many talents and gifts, especially among the sisters, that have not even been tapped into yet.

We have looked at this from a war perspective, and it is all-out war outside; we need brothers prepared to spread this gospel. But in the functioning of this body, the Lord is showing that there are many more things we have to prepare ourselves for. If we don't, we will stay stagnant like others have. The camps that taught their people not to go to school, because Christ is coming soon, cannot open one building to this day, because they taught their people not to achieve greatness.

God brings the different members in for a purpose that all serves the same thing, with different functions. Back in 2016 the vision was set forth: Original Royalty, the kitchen, the school with the kids, security, video, music, all components of a society, the body of Israel under Christ working together for the common good of the whole nation. What was vision then is old news now; that is what order and vision do for a nation.

note.label: Mindset Of A Leader, Actions Of A King

precepts.why:
“Follow after charity, and desire spiritual gifts, but rather that ye may prophesy.” That is why we deal with prophecy first. What we are watching in the news lines up with the scriptures: the fourth kingdom of Daniel 2, partly strong as iron and partly broken, mingling itself with the seed of men; and the ten horns of Revelation 17, NATO, that gave their power and strength unto the beast, America, since 1945, now turning on her, twenty-eight nations signing in the middle of the night to stand without the United States.

All the prophets saw the same thing. Habakkuk: “For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak, and not lie”. What we read in Revelation is for an appointed time, and it shall not lie; it is guaranteed. What we read in Isaiah, in Habakkuk, in Revelation will happen.

“though it tarry, wait for it”. We hear the Bishop bring out the revelations and the breakdowns, and it is taking its time, while the Christians do not have it at all; it is oblivious to their minds, distracted with prosperity doctrine. Wait for it: that is the counsel given to the elect. Be patient and get yourself right, because the vision will come to pass, and the nations will turn on each other.

“because it will surely come, it will not tarry”. Just as the Most High hardened Pharaoh's heart, he has a proud man in power who will say and do anything and take everybody's stuff; that is how it is going to happen. God put it in their hearts to fulfill his will, so we do not have to worry: we know what is going to happen before it happens.

precepts.text: Come out of her, my people, that ye be not partakers of her sins. Come out of religion, Christianity, and the philosophies and deceit, and repent.
precepts.point: But rather that ye may prophesy. That is why the class deals with prophecy first. A captain adds that the purpose of prophecy is to build your spirit and prepare you for temptation and destruction; when you see these things come to pass, know that Esau, Edom, America, is the enemy the Bible speaks of.

note.label: Mindset Of A Leader, Actions Of A King

precepts.why:
“but rather that ye may prophesy”. The purpose of prophecy is to build your spirit up and prepare you for temptation and destruction. Prophecy is warning: thus saith the Lord. When you see these things come to pass, know that Esau, Edom, America, is the enemy the Bible speaks of.

Revelation 18 gives the warning plainly. Babylon the great is fallen and has become the habitation of devils, and the call goes out: “Come out of her, my people, that ye be not partakers of her sins, and that ye receive not of her plagues.”

Come out of religion. Come out of these doctrines. Come out of Christianity. Come out of the lies and philosophies and deceit, and repent. The Christian church has you clapping on a tambourine while the prophecy is fulfilled before your eyes; they say the book of Revelation is sealed and cannot explain any of this.

That is why we covet to prophesy: so our people can see who Babylon is, come out of her, and not receive her plagues when the fire comes on her.

precepts.text: Come down and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon. America has never been touched, so she is the virgin; 9/11 was a controlled demolition. Now uncover the locks and make bare the leg: her nakedness is being uncovered as she allies with the little Satan and bombs other nations.

A captain adds that the purpose of prophecy is to build your spirit and prepare you for temptation and destruction; when you see these things come to pass, know that Esau, Edom, America, is the enemy the Bible speaks of.

note.label: Mindset Of A Leader, Actions Of A King

precepts.why:
“Come down, and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon, sit on the ground: there is no throne, O daughter of the Chaldeans”. The virgin daughter of Babylon is America. People try to say Babylon is somewhere else, but when has America been touched? The one thing that ever happened, they blew up themselves: 9/11 was the biggest controlled demolition anybody has ever witnessed. The virgin means she has not been touched, defiled or destroyed, until these prophecies are fulfilled. She is going to be touched.

“for thou shalt no more be called tender and delicate”. She thought she was tender and delicate, but that is coming to an end. As Daniel 2 showed, all manner of nations are within her, including her enemies: sleeper cells.

“Take the millstones, and grind meal: uncover thy locks, make bare the leg, uncover the thigh, pass over the rivers.” A virgin would be covered, but here her locks, leg and thigh are uncovered: the wickedness of Babylon, America, is being revealed.

“Thy nakedness shall be uncovered, yea, thy shame shall be seen: I will take vengeance, and I will not meet thee as a man.” What shame? How she allies herself with the little Satan and helps them bomb other countries, backing a demolition project to wipe out Gaza and its people, even renaming a whole body of water the Gulf of America. That is why the nations that benefited from her will grow to hate her, and prophecy lets us see it coming.

precepts.text: God is not the author of confusion, but of peace. Keep your house in order, because order protects in a crisis.
precepts.point: A pastor challenged the captain saying he eats people like him for dinner, so the captain took him to gluttony with thirty scriptures on the church page. Health is a doctrine too.

note.label: Prepare Ye War

precepts.why:
“For ye are bought with a price: therefore glorify God in your body, and in your spirit, which are God’s.” Your body is the temple, and you must be fit to serve; you cannot serve the Lord and be unfit.

Paul also says: “For God is not the author of confusion, but of peace, as in all churches of the saints.” Prepare ye war physically, and keep your house in order, because God is not the author of confusion, and order protects in a crisis.

When this empire collapses and global trade is disrupted, the ones who are ready will be the ones whose bodies are strong and whose houses are in order. A body kept under control and a house kept in order is how we glorify God in the body he bought with a price.

precepts.text: Follow after charity and desire spiritual gifts.
precepts.point: Prophesying is for edification, exhortation and comfort, so gifts are for the body and not for oneself.

note.label: The Kingdom Of Adam And The Old World

precepts.why:
“And he gave some, apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, pastors and teachers”. The Lord made some of us inside here apostles, some prophets, some evangelists, some pastors and teachers, and some brothers have several of these gifts. Why did God put his Holy Spirit in us and give us these gifts? Not so you can exalt yourself: I'm the mighty deacon, I understand all these things. It is “For the perfecting of the saints, for the work of the ministry”. The gift is not for your own selfish reasons. It is to make the brothers better and the people perfect, and to help your people. You brothers travelling the world teaching the gospel are waking people up all over the world.

So Paul says “Follow after charity, and desire spiritual gifts, but rather that ye may prophesy.” Desire spiritual gifts, but rather prophesy. Why? “But he that prophesieth speaketh unto men to edification, and exhortation, and comfort.”

When you prophesy you teach and edify the people. You exhort the brothers to continue in the faith and to have hope; that is how brothers develop hope and faith, when the prophets among us go into the scriptures and show certain things. That feeling inside when you hear brothers teach who can prophesy is exhortation, and it revives you.

And it comforts, because we need that comfort. We are all going through certain things, and we are all tired of this world and this life. But when we go into the scriptures and see the things the Lord has prepared for us, it comforts us and exhorts us to continue in this gospel and this work. That is why the gifts are for the body and not for oneself.

precepts.text: The women are commanded to be under obedience, as the law says from the beginning.
precepts.point: Sisters, if you do not allow your husband to rule over you, it does not matter what else you keep; you are not entering the kingdom without fulfilling this.

note.label: Genesis 3: The Craftiness of Your Enemy

precepts.why:
“Let your women keep silence in the churches: for it is not permitted unto them to speak; but they are commanded to be under obedience, as also saith the law.” The women are commanded to be under obedience, and Paul points back to the law for it, because the law says it from the beginning.

The beginning is Genesis 3:16: “thy desire shall be to thy husband, and he shall rule over thee.” Your desire, your learning, your desire of anything was to be to your husband, and he shall rule over thee. It is one of the first commandments given, alongside be fruitful and multiply, the Sabbath, and the commandment not to eat of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.

Sisters, if you do not allow your husband to rule over you, it does not matter what else you keep; you are not entering the kingdom without fulfilling this.

precepts.text: For if the trumpet give an uncertain sound, who shall prepare himself to the battle?
precepts.point: The sons of Aaron the priests blew the trumpets, an ordinance for ever throughout your generations. In war in your land against the enemy that oppresseth you, blow an alarm, and ye shall be remembered before the Lord your God and saved from your enemies. As Israel marched through the wilderness against the nations, the Most High remembered them and destroyed the enemy, as long as they were keeping the commandments.

note.label: Numbers 10: The Silver Trumpets and the Order of the Journeys

precepts.why:
“But when the congregation is to be gathered together, ye shall blow, but ye shall not sound an alarm.” The gathering was a longer sound, a different tone from the short alarm bursts of the journeys, letting everybody know this is the gathering.

“For if the trumpet give an uncertain sound, who shall prepare himself to the battle?” The sound had to be certain. If the priests blew an uncertain sound, people would sit still when it was time to go to war, or try to gather when it was time to go to war.

That is why the sons of Aaron the priests blew the trumpets as “an ordinance for ever throughout your generations”, and why in war “against the enemy that oppresseth you” they were to “blow an alarm with the trumpets; and ye shall be remembered before the Lord your God, and ye shall be saved from your enemies.” As Israel marched through the wilderness against the nations, the Most High remembered them and destroyed the enemy, as long as they were keeping the commandments.

precepts.text: Let all things be done decently and in order; the Most High is not the author of vengeance taken out of order.
precepts.point: This is why David is called a man after the Most High's own heart. He did not accept wickedness done in his name or let the murderers slide; he called them out and they received judgment for taking a man's life not ordained of the Lord nor commanded by the king. Let all things be done decently and in order.

note.label: 2 Samuel 4: The Slaying of Ishbosheth

precepts.why:
“Let all things be done decently and in order.” Rechab and Baanah slew Ish-bosheth in his own house upon his bed, a man at rest, asleep. It was not even a man-to-man contest for the kingdom. That is not how the Most High brings his purpose to pass, and he is not the author of vengeance taken out of order.

The Most High has his own way of doing things, and his people are not to put the cart before the horse. The kingdom was coming to David, but not by murder done in his name.

So David asked, “shall I not therefore now require his blood of your hand, and take you away from the earth?” They were slain, their hands and feet cut off, and they were hanged up over the pool in Hebron, while the head of Ish-bosheth was buried in the sepulchre of Abner. They received judgment for taking a man's life that was not ordained of the Lord nor commanded by the king. This is why David is called a man after the Most High's own heart: he did not accept wickedness done in his name or let the murderers slide.

precepts.text: Let all things be done decently and in order, the same standard by which the temple service was restored.
precepts.point: The service of the house of the Lord is set in order, and Hezekiah and the people rejoice that the thing was done suddenly, done decently and in order.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 29: Hezekiah Cleanses the House of the Lord

precepts.why:
“Let all things be done decently and in order.” That is the same standard by which the temple service was restored.

Once the people were consecrated, they brought so many sacrifices and thank offerings that “the priests were too few, so that they could not flay all the burnt offerings: wherefore their brethren the Levites did help them, till the work was ended”, “for the Levites were more upright in heart to sanctify themselves than the priests.” Everyone took his place, and the burnt offerings were “in abundance, with the fat of the peace offerings, and the drink offerings for every burnt offering.”

“So the service of the house of the Lord was set in order. And Hezekiah rejoiced, and all the people, that God had prepared the people: for the thing was done suddenly.” It was done suddenly, and it was done decently and in order.

precepts.text: Let all things be done decently and in order, according to the word.
precepts.point: Make Thy face to shine upon Thy servant, and teach me Thy statutes. A man's wisdom makes his face to shine, so the Israelites are to be illuminated with the wisdom of the law, letting our light shine among all nations in this kingdom of darkness. Rivers of waters run down mine eyes, because they keep not Thy law.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

precepts.why:
“Order my steps in thy word: and let not any iniquity have dominion over me.” “Let all things be done decently and in order.”

All things must be done decently and in order according to the scriptures, according to the word. So when a law or order comes out that agrees with this Bible, we must abide in it; that is our steps ordered in his word, so that no iniquity has dominion over us.
